game.name: Ssx (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: SSX is a totally arcade-oriented snowboarding game for Xbox 360. The player has to ride down dizzying slopes at high speed and perform crazy tricks. The title features many classic game modes, as well as a combination that allows your character to glide through the air. A new challenge in this game is to survive the dangers of the mountain.
game.genre: Racing, Driving, Sports, Sports / Skiing, Sports / Extreme
